mapper.select: select t.tag_id, t.student_id, t.paper_id, t.question_id, t.error_code, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, d.dict_label as error_label from spas_error_tag t left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'spas_error_cause' and d.dict_value = t.error_code and d.status = '0' where t.student_id = #{studentId} and t.question_id = #{questionId} limit 1

select t.tag_id, t.student_id, t.paper_id, t.question_id, t.error_code, t.remark, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, d.dict_label as error_label, st.student_name, q.question_no, p.paper_name from spas_error_tag t left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'spas_error_cause' and d.dict_value = t.error_code and d.status = '0' left join spas_student st on st.student_id = t.student_id left join spas_paper_question q on q.question_id = t.question_id left join spas_paper p on p.paper_id = t.paper_id where t.student_id = #{studentId} order by t.update_time desc nulls last, t.tag_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into spas_error_tag(student_id, paper_id, question_id, error_code, remark, create_by, create_time) values (#{studentId}, #{paperId}, #{questionId}, #{errorCode}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from spas_error_tag where student_id = #{studentId} and question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.select: select t.error_code as "errorCode", coalesce(d.dict_label, t.error_code) as "errorLabel", count(1) as "tagCount" from spas_error_tag t left join sys_dict_data d on d.dict_type = 'spas_error_cause' and d.dict_value = t.error_code and d.status = '0' where t.student_id = #{studentId} group by t.error_code, d.dict_label order by count(1) desc
